show.description: What happens when a bold girl with a past full of struggle crosses paths with a billionaire groom she never agreed to marry? Dumping Mr. Billionaire dives deep into a world of secret agendas, fake wives, and real emotions. This is not your regular love story. This is revenge with a twist of romance.
